serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table for bookedMin (capacity_bookings Order / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services), service_capacities reserved columns as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled labour minutes set aside for the bucket; bookedMin is the authoritative booked figure from that bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved column, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until someone edits the lot in the admin UI. daily_order_capacity is the UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling. null means not configured, which is not the same as zero.
